references.title: UU 13/2003 art.88E(1)-(2) as amended by UU 6/2023; PP 36/2021 arts.23(1)-(3), 24(1), 25 as amended by PP 51/2023 and PP 49/2025 - the UMK of the worksite, else the UMP; art.23(2): where the wage is basic plus non-fixed allowances the basic alone must reach it (`terms.rate.amount` plus fixed allowances). Art.24(1): the minimum binds a worker with less than one year of service; longer service follows the wage structure and scale (art.24(2)). Micro and small enterprises are outside it (art.36). Daily and hourly wages are DAILY_MINIMUM_WAGE and HOURLY_MINIMUM_WAGE.

Minimum wages from 1 January 2025 (PP 36/2021 as amended by PP 51/2023; Permenaker 16/2024: 6.5% on 2024). Keys and lookup as in the 2026 versions: every kota and kabupaten is listed at its UMK or at the UMP; the worksite (`employee_extension_data.work_region`), else the company region, by exact key; an absent key or the bare key of a province whose localities are listed refuses. Kalimantan Selatan UMKs 2025 re-read on Kep. 100.3.3.1/01089/KUM/2024 diktum KEDUA (the Disnakertrans Kalsel scan, 2026-10-08): Tanah Bumbu 3,500,163.21.
PP 36/2021 art.7(2): where the wage is basic plus fixed allowances, the basic wage is at least 75% of the total of basic wage and fixed allowances.

PP 36/2021 art.35D(1) as amended by PP 49/2025; the sector decrees and KBLI are stated in the second reference. Row conditions are customer inputs: exporter, assets above Rp1 trillion, Astra group, star hotel, bank category, class-A private hospital, rayon-viscose staple fibre, work in the PT Freeport Indonesia area (`entity_extension_data`), and the job category for the DKI bus and hospital rows (`employee_extension_data.umsp_job_category`); the worksite is `employee_extension_data.work_region` or the company region.

PP 36/2021 art.35D as in force in 2025 and Permenaker 16/2024 art.7: the governor’s sector minimum wages bind workers under one year of service. Version 1 (December 2025) seeds the 2025 decrees read from an official host: Mimika UMSK 2025 (Kep. Gubernur Papua Tengah 258/2024 diktum KESATU, read 2026-10-08 https://jdih.papuatengahprov.go.id/dokumen/view?id=783): mining (divisions 05–09) 6,000,000, construction (41–43) 5,130,819, and a construction company working in the PT Freeport Indonesia area pays the mining rate (entity_extension_data.umsp_freeport_area). The matching rules of the 2026 table apply (a KBLI code or prefix of employee_extension_data.worksite_kbli; a province key covers its localities; micro and small enterprises excluded). Kalimantan Selatan UMSK 2025 (Kep. Gubernur 100.3.3.1/01089/KUM/2024, 18 Dec 2024, from 1 January 2025, diktum KETIGA; the signed scan “KEPGUB UMK DAN UMSK TAHUN 2025” in the Disnakertrans Kalsel download centre, https://disnakertrans.kalselprov.go.id/unduhan?page=2, read 2026-10-08): Banjarmasin banking 3,609,682.13 (KBLI 641), hotels 3,603,182.13 (5511 and 5512: no star floor in 2025), wood 3,601,682.13 (division 16); Kotabaru coal 3,653,000 (05100), palm-oil and cooking-oil industry 3,646,004 (1043), palm plantation 3,646,004 (01262) — the sectors named without KBLI and read as in the 2026 decree. Any other 2025 worksite area warns (VALIDATIONS SECTOR_MINIMUM_WAGE_UNSEEDED, unseeded_sector.outside_tables).
